Everything in Mikkyy, plus system UI theming, status bar theming, icon masks, and the icon adjustments.

views.markdown:
- Everything in the free Mikkyy: themed app icons on every surface, plus live Calendar and Clock icons
- Settings rows, tab bars, and the system symbols used throughout iOS
- Control Center modules and tiles, share sheet icons, switch and slider knobs, the phone keypad, and weather artwork
- Status bar battery, signal, and Wi-Fi artwork, still turning red when low and yellow in Low Power Mode
- In-app artwork for themes that dress the inside of an app (optional)
- Icon masks, corner radius, icon size, hide icon labels, hide touch overlays, prefer 3x artwork
- Built to stay fast, even with themes that carry thousands of images

Installing Mikkyy Pro replaces the free package and keeps your settings.

Existing SnowBoard themes can be used as they are.

For full details and purchase information, please visit the [official website](https://m4fn3.github.io/repo/web/MikkyyPro.html).
